description: Intent i025 (SNAPSHOT=s04, branch=callee-pull-caller-stale) complete. One finding: s04:drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:1927-1990 (medium confidence). Evidence: caller mwl8k_txq_xmit() captures mgmt = (struct ieee80211_mgmt *)skb->data at line 1927 (untrusted source: packet bytes in skb->head on the mac80211/mwl8k TX path); at lines 1943/1945 it calls callees mwl8k_encapsulate_tx_frame()/mwl8k_add_dma_header() which internally call pskb_expand_head(skb, REDUCED_TX_HEADROOM=8, 0, GFP_ATOMIC) at mwl8k.c:867 when priv->ap_fw && hdrlen < sizeof(struct ieee80211_cts)+8, freeing/replacing skb->head (reload requirement documented in s04 net/core/skbuff.c:2277/2855); the caller refetches only wh at line 1947 and then dereferences the stale pre-call mgmt at lines 1987-1988 (mgmt->u.action.category, mgmt->u.action.action_code) and 1990 (mgmt->u.action.addba_req.capab), whose capab value selects tid/TX queue via mwl8k_tid_queue_mapping() at 1992 — a TX state transition through potentially freed slab memory, the interprocedural analogue of the seed's pep_get_sb() UAF. Negative evidence: an automated interprocedural scan ($TMPDIR/i025/scan.py) indexed every function body in s04 net/ and drivers/ for caller pointer captures held across calls to any callee containing pskb_may_pull/pskb_pull/__pskb_pull_tail/skb_linearize/skb_cow*/pskb_expand_head and produced only 3 chains tree-wide; xt_TCPMSS.c tg4 (line 198) and tg6 (line 221) were classified safe (callers refetch iph/ipv6h after the callee's internal pskb_expand_head at xt_TCPMSS.c:155, and flagged uses are pre-call arguments), and the l2tp callee->caller pairs l2tp_core.c:1096, l2tp_ip.c:166, l2tp_ip6.c:176 were classified safe because l2tp_v3_ensure_opt_in_linear() (l2tp_core.h:317) repairs both *ptr/*optr after its internal pskb_may_pull — the in-tree exemplar of the seed's fix. The callee-internal mwl8k wh case (line 867) was already reported by sibling intent i013 and is not re-counted. Limitations: static analysis only (no KASAN reproducer; expand precondition priv->ap_fw with hdrlen<26 not dynamically demonstrated), regex/name-based interprocedural matching (renamed skb args, macro captures, >200-line callee bodies, duplicate names, struct-carried state not covered; arch/ and fs/ not scanned), indirect dispatch boundaries (function pointers such as session->recv_skb, ndo chains) unresolved, and the skb is mac80211-generated TX traffic so byte-level attacker control is weaker than the seed's remote RX packet. Artifact written to agent-state/findings/i025.json with snapshots_checked exactly ["s04"].
